officials.summary: Verena Diener (27 March 1949 – 28 June 2024) was a Swiss politician. A member of the Green Liberal Party of Switzerland, she represented the canton of Zürich in the National Council from 1987 to 1998 and in the Council of States from 2007 to 2015.
